pages.title: Two Permissions
pages.text: Viewing access decides who can fetch the image shown on a screen.$(br2)Control access decides who can change its image.

pages.title: Two Permissions
pages.text: Neither permission grants ownership, access management, or another player's private library.

pages.title: Public and Trusted
pages.text: Public allows everyone for the selected permission.$(br2)Trusted players allows the owner, operators, and players on the trusted list.

pages.title: Public and Trusted
pages.text: Trusted membership has no effect until that permission uses Trusted players mode.

pages.title: Owner and Operators
pages.text: Owner only permits the owner and operators.$(br2)Operators only permits operators, even when the owner is not an operator. Owners still manage access and can change the policy.

pages.title: Owner and Operators
pages.text: Viewing starts Public; control starts Owner only.

pages.title: Access Updates
pages.text: Access settings reload when you open the screen or enter Settings.$(br2)Each edit receives the server's latest settings.

pages.title: Access Updates
pages.text: If someone changed them first, a stale edit is rejected and the latest settings are returned.
